main_text.l: IN CAPUT QUARTUM
An doctrina de signo & signato pertineat ad Metaphysicam;
& num recte a quibusdam referatur ad tractatum de
subiecto & adiunctis?
Duae sunt distinctae huius quaestionis partes; ideoque
etiam distinctae, una post aliam est explicanda. Ac
quod ad primam quidem partem attinet, distinguendum
est inter generalem & specialem doctrinam de signo & si-
gnato. Prior enim duntaxat pertinet ad Metaphysi-
cam, tanquam artem catholicam, quatenus signum &
signatum considerantur ut generalissima attributa enti-
um. Specialis vero pertinet ad alias artes particulares.
Hinc Medicus agit de signis salubribus & insalubribus;
Physicus de signis physiognomicis & prognosticis ven-
torum, pluviarum, aliarumque rerum futurarum; Theo-
logus, de signis sacris & mysticis. Quod autem ad al-
teram quaestionis partem attinet, sunt nonnulli ex Ra-
meis, qui doctrinam generalem de signo & signato re-

page.notes: Doubtful: "il-larem" at the line end of thesis 42 is unclear and marked [?]. The margin note is read as fragments split by line, joined here with its hyphens. Printed long s is written as plain s throughout. The numbers 42 to 50 are printed with spaces between the digits. The final paragraph breaks off at "re-" and continues on the next page.
